WITH rms AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT m.replay_id AS rid, m.played_at AS date_add, m.battle_type, m.winner_wizard_id FROM public.rta_match m INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant p0 ON p0.replay_id = m.replay_id AND p0.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p0.season_id = #{seasonId} WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY m.played_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), banned_pick AS ( SELECT ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id, MIN(ub.unit_master_id::text) AS banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick ub INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = ub.replay_id WHERE ub.is_banned = true GROUP BY ub.replay_id, ub.wizard_id ), user_info AS ( SELECT p.replay_id, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_id::text AS wizard_id_str, p.wizard_name, p.channel_uid, p.country_code AS country, CAST(p.ladder_score AS text) AS score, CAST(p.rating_id AS text) AS rating, CASE WHEN p.is_winner THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS result, CASE WHEN p.is_first_pick THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS first_pick, p.alive_count, p.leader_pick_slot, bp.banned_unit FROM public.rta_match_participant p INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = p.replay_id LEFT JOIN banned_pick bp ON bp.replay_id = p.replay_id AND bp.wizard_id = p.wizard_id ), unit_info AS ( SELECT u.replay_id, u.wizard_id, array_agg(u.unit_master_id::text ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units, array_agg( ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_images, array_agg(mo.kr_name ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_names, array_agg(u.is_banned ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS unit_banned_flags, string_agg(u.unit_master_id::text, ',' ORDER BY u.pick_slot_no) AS picked_units_str FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u LEFT JOIN public.monster mo ON mo.monster_id = u.unit_master_id::text INNER JOIN rms ON rms.rid = u.replay_id GROUP BY u.replay_id, u.wizard_id ), pair AS ( SELECT rms.rid, MIN(ui.wizard_id) AS p1w, MAX(ui.wizard_id) AS p2w FROM rms JOIN user_info ui ON ui.replay_id = rms.rid GROUP BY rms.rid ) SELECT rms.rid, rms.battle_type, rms.date_add, CASE WHEN rms.winner_wizard_id = pr.p1w THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS winner_position, u1.wizard_id_str AS p1_wizard_id, u1.channel_uid AS p1_channel_uid, u1.wizard_name AS p1_name, u1.country AS p1_country, u1.score AS p1_score, u1.rating AS p1_rating, u1.result AS p1_result, u1.first_pick AS p1_first_pick, u1.alive_count AS p1_alive_count, u1.banned_unit AS p1_banned_unit, u1.leader_pick_slot AS p1_leader_unit, COALESCE(un1.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_units, COALESCE(un1.unit_images, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_unit_images, COALESCE(un1.unit_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_unit_names, COALESCE(un1.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p1_unit_banned, COALESCE(un1.picked_units_str, '') AS p1_units_str, u2.wizard_id_str AS p2_wizard_id, u2.channel_uid AS p2_channel_uid, u2.wizard_name AS p2_name, u2.country AS p2_country, u2.score AS p2_score, u2.rating AS p2_rating, u2.result AS p2_result, u2.first_pick AS p2_first_pick, u2.alive_count AS p2_alive_count, u2.banned_unit AS p2_banned_unit, u2.leader_pick_slot AS p2_leader_unit, COALESCE(un2.picked_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_units, COALESCE(un2.unit_images, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_unit_images, COALESCE(un2.unit_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_unit_names, COALESCE(un2.unit_banned_flags, ARRAY[]::boolean[]) AS p2_unit_banned, COALESCE(un2.picked_units_str, '') AS p2_units_str FROM rms JOIN pair pr ON pr.rid = rms.rid JOIN user_info u1 ON u1.replay_id = rms.rid AND u1.wizard_id = pr.p1w JOIN user_info u2 ON u2.replay_id = rms.rid AND u2.wizard_id = pr.p2w LEFT JOIN unit_info un1 ON un1.replay_id = rms.rid AND un1.wizard_id = u1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN unit_info un2 ON un2.replay_id = rms.rid AND un2.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id ORDER BY rms.date_add DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT r.replay_id AS rid, r.battle_type, r.played_at AS date_add, COUNT(DISTINCT u.wizard_id) as player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.unit_master_id) as unit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.wizard_id) as pick_count FROM public.rta_match r LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON r.replay_id = u.replay_id LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick unit ON r.replay_id = unit.replay_id GROUP BY r.replay_id, r.battle_type, r.played_at ORDER BY r.played_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT 'rta_match_participant' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE replay_id = #{rid} UNION ALL SELECT 'rta_match_unit_pick' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick WHERE replay_id = #{rid}

WITH deleted AS ( DELETE FROM public.rta_agg_tier_daily WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} RETURNING 1 ) INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_tier_daily (season_id, bucket_date, grade_slot, player_count, sort_order, computed_at) SELECT #{seasonId}, d.bucket_date, d.grade_slot, d.player_count, d.sort_order, now() FROM (
) d ON CONFLICT (season_id, bucket_date, grade_slot) DO UPDATE SET player_count = EXCLUDED.player_count, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at
mapper.select: WITH match_total AS ( SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT t.total_matches::bigint FROM public.rta_agg_season_rating_match_total t WHERE t.season_id = #{seasonId} AND t.rating_id = #{ratingId} ), 0::bigint) AS total_matches ) SELECT s.combo_unit_key AS monster_id, m.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental, m.kr_name AS monster_name, AS monster_image, s.pick_cnt AS pick_count, ROUND((s.pick_cnt::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT mt.total_matches FROM match_total mt), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pick_rate, CASE WHEN s.match_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / s.match_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_rate, CASE WHEN s.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(s.ban_cnt, 0)::numeric / s.pick_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS ban_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = s.combo_unit_key WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id = #{ratingId} AND s.stat_kind = 'S' AND s.pick_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id = #{ratingId} AND s.stat_kind = 'D' AND s.match_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) AS monster_id_3, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, m3.kr_name AS monster_name_3, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, AS monster_image_3, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, m3.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_3, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap s INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) INNER JOIN public.monster m3 ON m3.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rating_id = #{ratingId} AND s.stat_kind = 'T' AND s.match_cnt >= #{minPickCount} AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m3.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH pick_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental as monster_elemental, m.kr_name as monster_name, as monster_image, COUNT(*) as pick_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant p ON u.replay_id = p.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u.unit_master_id::text WHERE m.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.image_url ), win_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as win_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON u.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id WHERE ul.is_winner = true AND NOT u.is_banned AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND ul.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ), ban_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as ban_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant p ON u.replay_id = p.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id WHERE u.is_banned = true AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ) SELECT ps.unit_master_id as monster_id, ps.monster_elemental, ps.monster_name, ps.monster_image, ps.pick_count, ROUND((ps.pick_count::numeric / NULLIF(mc.total_matches, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) as pick_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(ws.win_count, 0)::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, CASE WHEN (ps.pick_count + COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)::numeric / (ps.pick_count + COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)) * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as ban_rate FROM pick_stats ps CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.total_matches)::bigint, 0::bigint) AS total_matches FROM public.rta_agg_season_rating_match_total t WHERE t.season_id = #{seasonId} ) mc LEFT JOIN win_stats ws ON ps.unit_master_id = ws.unit_master_id LEFT JOIN ban_stats bs ON ps.unit_master_id = bs.unit_master_id LIMIT 1

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), opponent_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as opponent_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as opponent_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as opponent_monster_name, as opponent_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul1.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul1 ON mm.replay_id = ul1.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul1.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul2 ON mm.replay_id = ul2.replay_id AND u2.wizard_id = ul2.wizard_id AND ul1.wizard_id != ul2.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT opponent_monster_id as monster_id, opponent_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, opponent_monster_name as monster_name, opponent_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM opponent_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as combo_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as combo_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as combo_monster_name, as combo_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT combo_monster_id as monster_id, combo_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, combo_monster_name as monster_name, combo_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM combo_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( -- 내가 사용한 매치들 SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), triple_combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as monster1_id, m1.monster_elemental as monster1_elemental, m1.kr_name as monster1_name, as monster1_image, u3.unit_master_id as monster2_id, m2.monster_elemental as monster2_elemental, m2.kr_name as monster2_name, as monster2_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u3 ON mm.replay_id = u3.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u3.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = u3.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u3.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u2.unit_master_id < u3.unit_master_id AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m1.monster_elemental, m1.kr_name, m1.image_url, u3.unit_master_id, m2.monster_elemental, m2.kr_name, m2.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT monster1_id, monster1_elemental, monster1_name, monster1_image, monster2_id, monster2_elemental, monster2_name, monster2_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM triple_combo_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id, r.date_add FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u1.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ORDER BY r.date_add DESC LIMIT 20 ), my_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.replay_id, mm.wizard_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u1.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m1.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', COALESCE(, '') ) ORDER BY u1.pick_slot_no ) as my_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 ON mm.replay_id = u1.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = u1.unit_master_id::text GROUP BY mm.replay_id, mm.wizard_id ), opponent_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.replay_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u2.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m2.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', COALESCE(, '') ) ORDER BY u2.pick_slot_no ) as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id != u2.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text GROUP BY mm.replay_id ) SELECT mm.replay_id as match_id, mm.date_add as match_date, CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 'WIN' ELSE 'LOSE' END as win_lose, COALESCE(mt.my_team::text, '[]') as my_team, COALESCE(ot.opponent_team::text, '[]') as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN my_team_json mt ON mm.replay_id = mt.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = mt.wizard_id LEFT JOIN opponent_team_json ot ON mm.replay_id = ot.replay_id ORDER BY mm.date_add DESC

SELECT a.bucket_date, a.grade_slot AS "gradeSlot", rg.rating_id AS "ratingId", a.player_count, a.sort_order FROM public.rta_agg_tier_daily a LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.grade_slot = a.grade_slot WHERE a.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY a.bucket_date, a.sort_order
ORDER BY bucket_date, sort_order

WITH , rank_window AS ( SELECT (MAX(r.date_add)::date - INTERVAL '120 days')::date AS min_date FROM rta_match_in_season r ), rta_match_in_window AS ( SELECT r.rid, r.date_add, r.winner_wizard_id, r.battle_type FROM rta_match_in_season r INNER JOIN rank_window w ON r.date_add::date >= w.min_date ), anchors AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '3h', INTERVAL '3 hours'), (2, '6h', INTERVAL '6 hours'), (3, '12h', INTERVAL '12 hours'), (4, '3d', INTERVAL '3 days'), (5, '7d', INTERVAL '7 days') ) AS v(sort_order, anchor_key, iv) ), base AS ( SELECT r.date_add, u.ladder_score AS score_val, ( CASE WHEN u.rating_id >= 5000 THEN 60 WHEN u.rating_id >= 4000 THEN 50 WHEN u.rating_id >= 3500 THEN 40 WHEN u.rating_id >= 3000 THEN 30 WHEN u.rating_id >= 2000 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN (u.rating_id % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (u.rating_id % 10) ELSE 2 END ) AS tier_sort_order, ( CASE WHEN u.rating_id >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN u.rating_id >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN u.rating_id >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN u.rating_id >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN u.rating_id >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (u.rating_id % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (u.rating_id % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS grade_slot FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_window r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.rating_id >= 1000 AND u.ladder_score > 0 ), tiers AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('G3', 53), ('G2', 52), ('G1', 51), ('P3', 43), ('P2', 42) ) AS tv(grade_slot, tier_sort_order) ), , lower_bound AS ( SELECT a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.grade_slot, MAX(b.score_val)::bigint AS lower_max_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN base b ON b.tier_sort_order < t.tier_sort_order AND b.date_add >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv AND b.date_add <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, a.iv, t.grade_slot, t.tier_sort_order ) SELECT a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, rg.rating_id AS "ratingId", GREATEST( COALESCE(tof.min_pts, 0)::bigint, COALESCE(lb.lower_max_score + 1, 0)::bigint ) AS cutoff_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.grade_slot = t.grade_slot LEFT JOIN tier_official tof ON tof.grade_slot = t.grade_slot LEFT JOIN lower_bound lb ON lb.sort_order = a.sort_order AND lb.anchor_key = a.anchor_key AND lb.grade_slot = t.grade_slot ORDER BY a.sort_order, rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, rg.rating_id

SELECT s.sort_order, s.anchor_key, rg.rating_id AS "ratingId", s.cutoff_score FROM public.rta_rank_cutoff_anchor_snap s LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.grade_slot = s.grade_slot ORDER BY s.sort_order, rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, rg.rating_id

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.wizard_id) p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.country_code AS country, p.channel_uid, p.ladder_score AS score, p.rating_id, p.played_at AS last_match_at FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE p.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY p.wizard_id, p.played_at DESC ), win_agg AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_count FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE p.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} ), score_max AS ( SELECT MAX(p.ladder_score)::int AS max_season_score FROM public.rta_match_participant p WHERE p.wizard_id = #{wizardId} AND p.season_id = #{seasonId} ), rank_pos AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.wizard_id) + 1 AS rank_position FROM public.rta_match_participant p2 WHERE p2.season_id = #{seasonId} AND p2.ladder_score > (SELECT COALESCE(score, 0)::numeric FROM latest LIMIT 1) ) SELECT rp.rank_position, l.wizard_id::text AS wizard_id, l.wizard_name, l.country, l.channel_uid, l.score, l.rating_id, l.last_match_at, COALESCE(wa.match_count, 0)::bigint AS match_count, COALESCE(wa.win_count, 0)::bigint AS win_count, COALESCE(sm.max_season_score, l.score::int) AS max_season_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(wa.match_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(wa.win_count, 0)::numeric / wa.match_count::numeric, 1) ELSE NULL END AS win_rate_pct FROM latest l CROSS JOIN win_agg wa CROSS JOIN score_max sm CROSS JOIN rank_pos rp LIMIT 1

SELECT f.match_cnt::bigint AS match_cnt, f.non_ban_pick_cnt::bigint AS non_ban_pick_cnt, f.ban_event_cnt::bigint AS ban_event_cnt, f.computed_at FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap f WHERE f.season_id = #{seasonId} AND f.wizard_id = #{wizardId} LIMIT 1

SELECT s.unit_master_id::bigint AS unit_master_id, s.pick_cnt::bigint AS pick_cnt, s.ban_cnt::bigint AS ban_cnt, s.win_cnt::bigint AS win_cnt, s.lose_cnt::bigint AS lose_cnt, s.first_pick_cnt::bigint AS first_pick_cnt, s.owned_copy_count AS owned_copy_count, m.kr_name AS monster_name, m.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental, AS monster_image, CASE WHEN f.non_ban_pick_cnt IS NOT NULL AND f.non_ban_pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((100.0 * s.pick_cnt::numeric / f.non_ban_pick_cnt::numeric), 2) END AS pick_rate_pct, CASE WHEN f.ban_event_cnt IS NOT NULL AND f.ban_event_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((100.0 * s.ban_cnt::numeric / f.ban_event_cnt::numeric), 2) END AS ban_rate_pct, CASE WHEN s.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((100.0 * s.win_cnt::numeric / s.pick_cnt::numeric), 2) END AS win_rate_pct, CASE WHEN s.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((100.0 * s.first_pick_cnt::numeric / s.pick_cnt::numeric), 2) END AS first_pick_rate_pct FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap s LEFT JOIN public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap f ON f.season_id = s.season_id AND f.wizard_id = s.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = s.unit_master_id::text WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.wizard_id = #{wizardId} ORDER BY s.pick_cnt DESC, s.unit_master_id ASC
